name: Chris Williamson Style
summary: Editable captions and verified B-roll with preserved manual edits, an openly licensed music bed (Kevin MacLeod, CC BY 4.0), no full-screen flashes or shutter sounds.

compatibility.selects: Requires the public selects.ai SDK and selects-ai-runtime installed from the same full library commit, plus current Selects panel runScript/askAI, getDraftCore/captureVisualFrames and host ffmpeg/FileSystem services. Shared YuNet face detection runs on CPU on macOS and Windows; macOS still uses runShell and its pinned Node.js engine for shot/B-roll preparation. Released-host compatibility must be verified with the installed build.
